The main story today is a study of groups of agents (AI programs that carry out tasks) discussing factual questions, testing the effect of one adversary repeatedly asserting a false answer [1](https://example.com/1). With that adversary present, the share of agents giving the false answer rose from 0.6% to 44.8% [1](https://example.com/1).
